answer: Resist sybils with a mesa bond: each new identity locks spendable stake proportional to its attestation fan-out. A falcon peer panel randomly samples that bond before countersigning; forged clones fail the sample and lose the lock. Enforcement is peer-local: any attester who skips the check risks a quill slash recorded on-ledger by other panelists, so an attacker pays capital plus reputation for every fake identity.
